title: Pocketwire Advance Tier Schedule — Limits and Advance Sizing
content:
The Pocketwire Advance tier of a line fixes how large its advances can be, in what steps they are requested and how many can run at the same time. Every figure below is read from the tier the line holds on the day of the advance.

## Schedule

| Tier | Advance limit (USD) | Plan limit bonus (USD) | Smallest advance (USD) | Advance increment (USD) | Advances outstanding at once | Advances per calendar month | Wait after a full repayment (full hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 50.00 | 0.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 1 | 2 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 100.00 | 25.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 1 | 2 | 24 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 200.00 | 25.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 1 | 3 | 12 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 300.00 | 50.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 2 | 4 | 12 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 400.00 | 50.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 2 | 4 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 500.00 | 100.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 3 | 5 | 0 |

## What each column means

- **Advance limit** — the maximum total advance principal outstanding on the line at one time, before any plan bonus.
- **Plan limit bonus** — the amount added to the advance limit while the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account is on Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit.
- **Smallest advance** — the smallest single advance the line can take.
- **Advance increment** — advances are requested in whole multiples of this amount.
- **Advances outstanding at once** — the maximum number of advances not yet repaid at the same time on the line.
- **Advances per calendar month** — the maximum number of advances disbursed in one calendar month.
- **Wait after a full repayment** — the number of full hours after an advance is repaid in full before a new advance can be disbursed.

## Reading the schedule

- The increment is 5.00 on every tier, so an amount such as 42.50 or 63.00 is never a valid advance amount on any Pocketwire Advance tier, while 45.00 or 60.00 is a whole multiple of the increment.
- The smallest advance is 20.00 on every tier; on Pocketwire Advance Starter, whose advance limit is 50.00, the whole multiples of 5.00 from 20.00 to 50.00 are the amounts the schedule allows.
- On Pocketwire Advance Max and Pocketwire Advance Elite the wait after a full repayment is 0 full hours: the schedule places no waiting time between repaying one advance in full and disbursing the next.
- Pocketwire Advance Plus and Pocketwire Advance Max allow 2 advances outstanding at once and Pocketwire Advance Elite allows 3; every lower tier allows 1.
